kbmi.loc: AR2025 PDF p. 61, Key Metrics: 'Capital Tier (Tier 1)' Rp6,475,768 juta at 31 Dec 2025
kbmi.note: KBMI 2 = core capital Rp6tn to below Rp14tn (POJK 12/POJK.03/2021). AR2023 PDF p. 7 states that core capital rose above Rp6tn at end-2023 'sehingga CCB Indonesia memenuhi syarat untuk ditingkatkan ke kategori KBMI 2' (early 2024); AR2023 PDF p. 132 still says KBMI 1 for 2023. AR2024/AR2025 award pages (AR2025 PDF p. 34) use 'KBMI 2, Swasta Asing'. Tier 1 was Rp6,690,613 juta at 30 Sep 2026 (published report PDF p. 7), still only ~11% above the KBMI 1/2 boundary.

validation_ack.reason: PUT V added 21,288,269,763 shares in July 2020 (rights ex-date 2020-06-25), so the FY2020 audited FS compute basic EPS Rp1.91 on a weighted average of 26,112,302,203 shares (Note 32, PDF p. 128 of https://www.bankccbi.co.id/storage/documents/business-financial-audited/LKT%202020.pdf): 1.91 x 26,112,302,203 = Rp49.9bn = reported profit Rp49,979 juta. FY-end shares are 37,919,730,514. Real weighted-average effect, not a data error.

research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: every document came straight from the bank's own website https://www.bankccbi.co.id (plain curl with a browser User-Agent on 2026-11-03, no bot challenge). The bank moved its website from idn.ccb.com to bankccbi.co.id effective 12 Sep 2025 (disclosure https://www.bankccbi.co.id/news/151); idn.ccb.com still resolves but now presents the bankccbi.co.id TLS certificate (name mismatch), so it was not used. Older documents (2020 prospectus, AR2019) sit under legacy paths (/fabercms/..., /res/annual/...) on the new domain. idx.co.id was not needed.

ENTITY / BASIS: PT Bank China Construction Bank Indonesia Tbk (ticker MCOR from its predecessor PT Bank Multicor Tbk; renamed PT Bank Windu Kentjana International Tbk in 2007/2008; renamed PT Bank China Construction Bank Indonesia Tbk by the EGMS of 11 Nov 2016 (effective 30 Nov 2016) after China Construction Bank Corporation entered as the 60% controlling shareholder, and merged with its fully owned subsidiary PT Bank Antardaerah on 30 Nov 2016; AR2025 PDF pp. 11-12, LKT 2025 Note 1, PDF pp. 23-24). It has no subsidiaries or associates (AR2025 PDF p. 20); the audited statements are non-consolidated 'Laporan Keuangan' = the whole entity. Money fields carry basis 'consolidated' (validator rule, same approach as MEGA/BBYB), ratios 'bank_only' as printed in the OJK ratio tables. equity_attr = total_equity (no NCI). Auditor FY2024-FY2025: Ernst & Young member firms (KAP Purwantono, Sungkoro & Surja; KAP Purwanto, Susanti dan Surja).

UNITS: all audited FS (FY2019-FY2025), the interim FS and the published reports are in Rp juta (divided by 1,000; full precision kept). The FY2019-FY2023 'LKT' files on the bank site are the audited FS sections extracted from the ARs (same PDF creation dates).

NO DIVIDENDS FY2019-FY2025: every AGMS (31 Aug 2020, 26 Aug 2021, 22 Jul 2022, 6 Jun 2023, 7 Jun 2024, 23 Jun 2025, 12 Jun 2026) put Rp500m into the statutory reserve and the rest of the year's profit into retained earnings 'untuk memperkuat struktur permodalan'. payout_ratio is stored as 0 for FY2020-FY2025 with the AGMS minutes as source; the dividends list is empty on purpose.

CORPORATE ACTIONS 2019-2026: exactly one - the PUT V rights issue (100 old : 128 rights at Rp150; ex-date regular market 2020-06-25; 21,288,269,763 new shares, fully subscribed: CCB Corporation exercised all its rights (9,978,756,012 -> 22,751,563,707 shares, 60.00%), Johnny Wiraatmadja declared he would not exercise and would transfer his rights (holding unchanged at 3,546,603,605); standby buyer PT Sinar Mas Multiartha Tbk). No split, reverse split or bonus issue ever (AR2025 PDF p. 27 'Chronology of Shares Listing': last earlier events PUT IV July 2016 and Series II warrant conversions to Dec 2016; '2025: no addition of new shares'). Share count 16,631,460,751 (2016-Jun 2020) -> 37,919,730,514 (Jul 2020 to 30 Sep 2026). Because the ex-date is before 2020-12-31, fy.2019.year_end_price (129, share_basis 2019-12-31) is stored. NOTE FOR THE PRICE FETCHER: the Rp150 exercise price was above the market (cum-date closes ~113-142), so the theoretical ex-rights price (100 x P + 128 x 150) / 228 is ABOVE the cum price; any Yahoo 'rights factor' should be ~1 or >1, not the usual <1 - a reviewer should check the measured factor against the 2019 (129) and 2020 (139) AR closes.
EPS FY2020 uses the weighted-average share count (26.11bn) because of PUT V - acknowledged in validation_ack (eps_shares:2020). FY2021-FY2025 EPS x 37.92bn shares match reported profit within 0.3%.

RATIO SOURCES: CAR (total), NPL gross/net, ROA, ROE, NIM, BOPO, CIR ('Rasio Biaya terhadap Pendapatan' / 'Cost to Income Ratio') and LDR come from each year's own AR highlights 'Rasio Keuangan' table (AR2020 p. 26, AR2021 p. 29, AR2022 p. 28, AR2023 p. 28, AR2024 p. 28, AR2025 p. 29); FY2025 values are identical in the Dec 2025 OJK published report (PDF p. 9). Later ARs restate two FY2020 values: NIM 2.84% -> 2.82% and CAR credit-risk-only 38.40% -> 38.60% (first-published NIM kept). CASA comes from the MD&A text of each AR (2020 28.9%, restated 28.85% in AR2021; 2022 22.52%, restated 22.56% in AR2023). CoC, LAR (FY) and NPL coverage are not disclosed anywhere the bank publishes (AR2020-AR2025 ratio tables/MD&A, annual Paparan Publik decks 2021-2026; the OJK published-report ratio table, checked for Dec 2025/Mar 2026/Sep 2026, has no CoC or coverage line and adds KKR only from Sep 2026) - null, not computed. The interim LAR is the new OJK 'Kredit Kualitas Rendah (KKR)' line of the 30 Sep 2026 published report.

9M2026: profit Rp217.4bn (-5.8% YoY); customer deposits fell 12.3% YTD to Rp25.2tn (time deposits Rp21.7tn -> 16.8tn) while loans grew to Rp27.4tn, so LDR jumped to 108.58% and repo liabilities reached Rp3.5tn; CAR 27.70%. The ratios are real as printed (published report PDF p. 9), not unit slips.
KBMI: KBMI 1 up to 2023 (AR2023 PDF p. 132), KBMI 2 from early 2024 after Tier 1 passed Rp6tn (AR2023 PDF p. 7); Tier 1 Rp6.48tn at Dec 2025 and Rp6.69tn at Sep 2026.

DATA QUALITY: the AR2019 monthly share-price table is internally inconsistent (e.g. Desember 2019 high 140 / low 131 / close 129); the quarterly table and 'Harga pada akhir tahun' (129) agree with the AR2020 two-year table, so 129 is stored. AR2019 also prints Q4 2019 market cap Rp2,124.0bn, which is not 129 x the 16.63bn issued (Rp2,145.5bn) or 16.37bn listed shares. RUPST 2025 minutes state FY2024 profit as Rp295,400,314,095 vs Rp295,402 juta in the audited FS (Rp1.7m difference; audited figure stored).
